summary: A resident who cannot join the traveling party still has a chance to present something made in town.
realLife: Bray recalled community representatives who could not ride on greeting Truman after his speech and sometimes giving him a local product.
inGame: needs: presenter availability and a local gift.

turns.pulledBy: The presenter must stay in town.
turns.what: The host arranges a short presentation at the stop.
turns.writesBack: The giver can explain the item in person.

turns.pulledBy: The presentation cannot fit before departure.
turns.what: The host asks for the giver's name and a note about the item.
turns.writesBack: The campaign can acknowledge it afterward.
